correctness.rationale: For any full-dimensional compact convex K⊂R^d,d≥2, the exact Fubini chord reduction at p=−1+ε gives ρ_T/μ=(E Z^ε)^(1/(ε−1)). Chord concavity on the projection D bounds normalized chords 0<Z≤d and P(Z<t)≤(d−1)t, uniformly in K,u; hence logZ has uniformly bounded moments and cumulant derivatives through order three for ε≤1/4. Φ(0)=0, Φ′(0)=−J, Φ″(0)=V; Taylor divided by ε−1 yields εJ+ε²(J−V/2)+O_d(ε³). Berwald gives 0≤J≤H_(d−1)−log d, sharp prism/conical roof; pointwise g(z)=z−1−log z yields J≥E(Z−1)²/(2d²). Polar integration yields the stated volume coefficients; some direction has nonconstant chords (e.g. a diameter direction) so positive first coefficient. Independently evaluated Beta(1,d−1) cone moment expansions for d=2,3,5,9; this is corroboration only. No d-uniform remainder or optimal C_d claimed.
